scope: 27 process implementation mathematics and ultra-performance Flutter runtime architecture

findings.resolution: Every one of 27 processes now has the same mandatory 25-section implementation dossier.
Per-process equations, exact/bounded arithmetic, inclusivity and comparison semantics are frozen.
Worst-case, governing-case and limiting-factor algorithms are explicit per process.
All 27 processes require positive, boundary, negative, adversarial and cross-discipline vectors.
Every process has algorithmic complexity/resource bounds and scale expectations.
Medium/large native engineering work is required to execute outside the Flutter UI isolate through an executor boundary.
Web execution explicitly does not treat Flutter compute() as a separate isolate; chunked/qualified policy is required.
Batch DAG, canonical aggregation and worker-count/order determinism are normative.
Cancellation, supersession and coalescing prevent obsolete jobs from publishing or growing an unbounded queue.
Result reuse key includes process/algorithm/schema/numeric/authority and canonical input fingerprints.
Capture/publish require short bounded transactions, bulk repository access, indexes and query-plan evidence.
Engineering work in build(), global rebuilds and eager huge lists are forbidden; targeted immutable projections and virtualization are required.
Profile-mode frame budgets, scale fixtures, controlled benchmark evidence and exact-head performance artifacts are required.
Worker failure/cancellation cannot partially advance a coherent calculation batch; guarded publication remains atomic.
Each process dossier defines stable equation-code families and deterministic trace expectations.
Each process includes a cross-discipline/stage vector proving ELV3/4 reuse and ELV6/7/8 claim boundaries.
What-if calculations use the same pure kernels but are cancellable, bounded, lower-priority and non-publishable as CURRENT.
Deterministic structural performance gates are separated from controlled-runner timing regression evidence.

ACS-03 reference-vector arithmetic was independently recomputed; the canonical 24 V / 0.8 A / 0.5 ohm trunk plus 0.3 A / 0.3 ohm branch terminal value is corrected to 23.51 V in normative calculation-oracle errata, and executable vectors must use the corrected value.
